children: AI research workflow platform's Q4 revenue beat analyst expectations despite slight yr/yr decline
Q4 net income fell yr/yr due to prior-year favorable adjustment for Scite earnout
Full-year net income more than doubled, driven by platform revenue growth and improved gross margin
Company says it has a large pipeline of AI-related revenue opportunities for FY27
Research Solutions plans continued investment in internally developed tools and strategic M&A
PLATFORM MIX SHIFT - Co said higher-margin Platforms business accounted for a greater share of revenue, driving gross margin improvement
B2B ARR GROWTH - Q4 platform subscription revenue rose due to 14% increase in B2B ARR from new customers and upselling, partially offset by B2C ARR decline
TRANSACTION REVENUE DECLINE - Transaction revenue fell due to lower paid order volume
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the online services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Research Solutions Inc is $4.00, about 83.5% above its September 8 closing price of $2.18
The stock recently traded at 15 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 15 three months ago
